test_scope: Synthetic annual series and fields only
independent_checks: SciPy simple OLS, Theil-Sen and Kendall references
Explicit joint OLS coefficients, standard errors and partial correlations
Actual-year lag pairs and effective degrees of freedom
Known BH adjusted p values and explicit test families
limits: Synthetic checks do not validate a specific climate mechanism
Lag-one inference is an approximation, not HAC
Nominal trend tests do not correct serial dependence
Block bootstrap requires complete consecutive annual records
